articles.summary: 30-day data from the FORWARD CAD IDE study demonstrate favorable safety and efficacy outcomes for the Shockwave Javelin Coronary Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) catheter when used to modify highly stenosed, challenging calcific coronary lesions
articles.title: Johnson & Johnson’s Novel Shockwave Javelin Coronary IVL Catheter Delivers Positive Results in Pivotal FORWARD CAD IDE Study
